description: Unofficial Kenma Kozume fan-art companion inspired by Haikyu!!. Independently drawn in his red-and-black number 5 school uniform, with a dark-root blond bob, a quiet handheld-game and soft-volleyball idle, gentle setting practice, tactic-paper review, harmless recovery and three-direction low defensive running. Familiar costume cues are artistic interpretations, not newly verified official costume pixels. This original animation is not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
